description: Nationwide public holidays for a year in the US (federal), UK (England and Wales), Sweden, Germany, France, Norway, Denmark and Finland: date, local and English name, and the weekday it is observed on where a weekend moves it. Computed from statutory rules for 2024-2100. Use for scheduling, delivery dates and business-day maths. Example: country=SE, year=2026. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
